method: Official Cook County Socrata adapter bounded-query and exact-ID verification; 3x3 grid of 0.0025-degree cells at WUP Chicago center and same grid shifted +0.004 degrees lon/lat. Polygon data were held in memory only; this record contains no parcel IDs or geometries.

source.publisher: Cook County Clerk / Map Department (Cook County GIS)
source.vintage: Tax parcel polygons as they existed 2021-01-01 through 2021-12-31

nativeGroundKey.definition: 10-digit base parcel number: first 10 digits of 14-digit PIN

source.attribution: Cook County Clerk / Map Department; source 2021 tax parcel geometry adapted to WGS84.

adapterFailureSemantics.timeout: one cell returned two HTTP 200 responses followed by a fetch network timeout; adapter surfaced 504
adapterFailureSemantics.integrity: two cells and two exact-ID batches were rejected by adapter geometry-conflict checks (adapter status 502); all captured underlying HTTP responses for those reads were 200

batches.conflictsParceltype: all conflicting PIN10 groups contain parceltype 1 only
the conflicting PIN10 group contains parceltype 1 only

conflictTypeDiagnostic.filterAssessment: The publisher defines parceltype=1 as Baseparcel, but every geometry conflict was already parceltype=1; filtering to the documented baseparcel type does not resolve the key conflicts.

priorCurrentRouteReview.outcome: direct bounded requests timed out; no complete bbox/exact-ID proof

environmentNote: An initial default-sandbox shell attempt could not resolve datacatalog.cookcountyil.gov; this was a local sandbox DNS restriction, not a provider failure. Authorized escalated network execution reached the dataset and produced the results above.
technicalBlockers: 2021 bounded pagination did not complete all 18 cells: one fetch timed out and two cells failed the adapter geometry-conflict check.
Two exact-ID batches also failed because multiple parceltype=1 polygons share a PIN10; first-winner geometry selection would be lossy and is not permitted.
Current 2025/ArcGIS service routes timed out during the prior review; current runtime reliability is unproven.
decision: Do not integrate/enable Cook/Chicago from this candidate until a current source or an authoritative native key safely resolves geometry conflicts and all bounded/exact gates pass.
